summary.text: Stephanie Young is the Democratic state representative for Michigan House District 16, a member of the Michigan House since 2021, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists her career experience as including executive director of the Community Education Commission and chief of staff and legislative liaison for three state representatives.

paragraphs.text: Stephanie Young was born in Detroit and graduated from Cass Technical High School.
She earned a bachelor's degree in international relations and affairs from James Madison College at Michigan State University in 1990.

Her career has included work as executive director of the Community Education Commission, district one manager with the Detroit Mayor's Office Department of Neighborhoods, and outreach manager of the Detroit Area Agency on Aging.
In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, she said her first job was as a legislative staffer and that she has worked in four Detroit mayoral administrations.

In that survey, Young said District 16 covers northwest Detroit, including the Brightmoor, Castle Rouge, West Outer Drive Civic Association and Grandmont-Rosedale communities, along with southern Livonia and part of Redford Charter Township.
For 2025-2026 she was assigned to the Financial Services Committee and was Minority Vice Chair of the Families, Children, and Seniors Committee, which she chaired in 2023-2024.
